headline: IBM has released Granite Switch 4.1, two open language models that bundle a safety checker, a decision tool and a speech-to-text encoder into one endpoint.
score_reason: Technical release mostly of interest to developers; comparisons are IBM's own.
importance_line: Developers get open, small models with a built-in safety check and speech transcription that need about the same memory as the base model, but IBM's comparisons are its own and the speech part works only in English.
summary: Unite.AI reports that IBM announced Granite Switch 4.1 on 15 October 2026, releasing 8-billion and 30-billion-parameter models under the Apache 2.0 open licence, each combining a base model, a decision adapter, a safety adapter and an English speech-to-text encoder in one hosted endpoint. IBM says the extra parts need roughly the same graphics memory as the base model alone; the published limits include that speech works only in English and a mistranscription can silently change the answer.
notes: Full text read. Comparisons are IBM's own.
